name: Amongst the Ruins
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Je'neu Sancrea sends Horde adventurers into Blackfathom Deeps for a fathom core. The Earthen Ring hopes the relic will reveal what the Twilight's Hammer is doing with the elements.

sections.title: A Threat in the Deep
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer has taken hold of Blackfathom Deeps, the ancient night elven temple once sacred to Elune. Its cultists command the submerged passages. At Zoram'gar Outpost on Ashenvale's shore, Darkspear shaman Je'neu Sancrea watches the corruption spread. He fears the cult means to bend the local elements against the land and its defenders.

sections.title: The Fathom Stone
sections.body: Je'neu Sancrea sends Horde champions to retrieve a fathom core from the fathom stone beneath the waters of the Moonshrine Ruins. Shamans who can decipher the core will find a detailed record of elemental currents and disturbances. The Earthen Ring hopes the relic will expose the Twilight's Hammer's work and help keep the region safe from elemental disaster.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Amongst the Ruins?
faq.answer: Je'neu Sancrea gives the task. The Darkspear troll serves the Earthen Ring at Zoram'gar Outpost, along the Zoram Strand in western Ashenvale.

A fathom core is an artifact held within a submerged fathom stone in the ruins. Shamans can read it for a record of elemental activity, including how the local elements are being forced and manipulated.

faq.q: Why is the Earthen Ring concerned about Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: why does the earthen ring care
faq.answer: The Earthen Ring seeks balance among the elements. The Twilight's Hammer has taken over the submerged ruins and is corrupting and coercing the elements, threatening the region's stability.

faq.q: Where is the fathom stone located?
faq.answer: The fathom stone lies beneath the waters of the Moonshrine Ruins inside Blackfathom Deeps. Explorers must dive below the surface to retrieve its core.

faq.q: Can Alliance players take this quest?
aliases: can alliance do amongst the ruins
faq.answer: No. Only Horde adventurers can take on this work. Je'neu Sancrea is based at the Horde outpost of Zoram'gar and supports the Horde's presence in Ashenvale while serving the Earthen Ring.

faq.q: What group is occupying Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: The Twilight's Hammer occupies Blackfathom Deeps. The cult serves sinister Old God beings and twists the elements toward catastrophic ends.

angles.text: As a shaman, retrieving the fathom core helps the Earthen Ring protect the spirits of water and earth from the Twilight's Hammer's coercion.
As a member of the Horde, clearing threats from Blackfathom Deeps helps protect Zoram'gar Outpost and the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's coast.
As a troll, aiding Je'neu Sancrea means helping a fellow Darkspear who connects the Horde with the Earthen Ring's elemental caretakers.
